newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Credit Lyonnais sets call, put warrants on KL index.
newsitem.headline: Credit Lyonnais sets call, put warrants on KL index.

text.p: Credit Lyonnais Financial Products (Guernsey) Ltd said on Monday it has issued four tranches of American style warrants, two put and two call, on the Kuala Lumpur Composite Index (KLCI).
EXERCISE RATIO 10 warrants for one Index
REFERENCE PRICE Closing spot price of KLCI on November 4
coverted into U.S. dollar at prevailing rate
ISSUE SIZE Tranche A & B: 1.50 million warrants
STRIKE PRICE Call A: 90 pct of the KLCI Reference Price
Call B: 100 pct of the KLCI Reference Price
Put C : 90 pct of the KLCI Reference Price
Put D : 100 pct of the KLCI Reference Price
ISSUE PRICE Call A: 1.715 pct of the KLCI Reference Price
Call B: 1.045 pct of the KLCI Reference Price
Put C : 0.298 pct of the KLCI Reference Price
Put D : 0.650 pct of the KLCI Reference Price
